skill_title: Calculate the effect of inflation over single and multiple periods
notes: 20-item bank, Grade 12 only. CAPS mix: 5 L1 / 8 L2 / 7 L3. Single period: new = old × (1 + i). Multi period (compound): new = old × (1 + i)^n.

stimulus.inline: Inflation: each year prices rise by i%. Single year formula: new = old × (1 + i).

_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_PERCENT_INCREASE: Forgets to add inflation to the original amount.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_PERCENT_TO_DECIMAL: Misconverts inflation rate to decimal multiplier.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_PERCENT_SUCCESSIVE_ADD: Adds successive inflation rates instead of compounding.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_COMPOUND_AS_SIMPLE: Treats inflation as simple growth (adds the same amount each year).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_POWER_OF_FACTOR: Doesn't raise (1 + i) to the power n for multi-year inflation.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_REAL_VS_NOMINAL: Confuses today's vs future-Rand purchasing power.
